Hello,

With Proxmox 8 we had installed Veeam Agent for Linux on each hypervisors to have a backup of the system disks.

But it is no more possible with Proxmox 9.2.
Veeam Agent for Linux install a kernel module via DKMS, but it is not compatible with the current PVE kernel (kernel 7).
For Debian based distribution it is only compatible with the official kernel : 6.12
https://www.veeam.com/kb2804

Does someone knows a way to install it ?
